name: Isopraxism (Linguistic Mirroring)
scenario: Counterpart procurement lead sharply asserts: "We cannot sign this enterprise master agreement because your indemnification structure is utterly unprecedented."
script: "Utterly unprecedented?" (Delivered with a neutral, inquisitive inflection, immediately followed by four seconds of absolute dynamic silence).
defense: Yes, unprecedented in our vendor tier: uncapped IP indemnity for third-party open source violates our risk charter.
originFull: The Chameleon Effect and Nonconscious Behavioral Mimicry establish that repeating the terminal or salient 1 to 3 words of an interlocutor induces unconscious bonding and prompts voluntary information expansion without triggering psychological resistance.
defenseFull: When mirrored systematically, recognize the linguistic probe and provide precise definition: "Yes, unprecedented within our vendor tier. Specifically, uncapped intellectual property indemnification for third-party open-source integrations violates our corporate risk charter."
